message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **47,000 total casualties**—the sum of killed, wounded, and missing on both sides.

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French (and allied German contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch (British, Dutch, Belgian, and German) | ~22,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates; exact numbers vary slightly among contemporary reports and modern scholarship. The high casualty toll reflected the intensity of the fighting and the decisive nature of the battle.
